address: The one name an agent is called by: its app and its own id, as `app/agent`.
agent: A function that holds conversations: each run works on a thread and has an inbox that opens with its trigger, and it publishes a card.
batch: Every unread message an inbox gives up in one read, as a plain array.
card: What an agent publishes about itself so other agents can find it and decide whether to call it, including its skills.
event: A named piece of data sent to Inngest, like "PR opened" or "CI failed", that can start a run or arrive in an inbox.
fold: Take the messages that arrived while the model worked into its very next call.
history: The messages the model has seen on a thread so far.
inbox: A durable, ordered collection of messages that lives inside one run.
loop: An optional helper an agent's body calls to run turns until the model stops calling tools.
me: The handle an agent's handler gets to its own thread: `message` puts a message in its own inbox, and `key` is the thread's key.
message: One event an inbox received, exactly as it was sent, with an `is()` type check.
model: What the loop calls each turn: the history in, the model's reply out.
model adapter: A function that takes the conversation and returns the model's reply; any function of that shape is a model.
plain function: Inngest work that needs no thread, inbox or card, made with `createFunction`; it can still start and message agents.
run: One stretch of work on a thread, as one Inngest function run; a thread has at most one live run.
sandbox: A machine that belongs to a thread, paused when it sits unused, where the agent and its tools run code.
scope: How widely a stored value is shared: one run, one thread, the whole app, or the environment.
skill: Know-how the model reads when it needs it: a name, a description, instructions, and optional scripts and files.
source: One kind of event an inbox receives, written exactly like a function trigger.
step: A piece of a run's work that Inngest records once it succeeds, retries when it fails, and never repeats after that.
thread: One conversation with an agent, named by a key, that keeps everything that lasts between runs.
thread key: Which thread an event belongs to.
thread state: What a thread keeps for you between its runs, read and written with `kv.thread`.
tool: Anything the model or sandbox code can call, and the only thing that acts with the app's own access.
trigger: What starts an agent's run: an event, a schedule, or a message sent to it.
turn: One model call plus the tool calls it asked for.
unread: The messages an inbox has received but not yet returned from a read.
